title: File:Foreign Secretary David Lammy meets Sudanese refugees in Chad in the border town of Adre on 24 January 2025 - 1.jpg
author: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office
description: 24 January 2025, Adre, Chad. Foreign Secretary David Lammy meets Sudanese refugees who have fled the conflict in Sudan, which broke out in April 2023. Since then, almost 1 million people have fled from Sudan into Chad. Over 230,000 of them are in informal camps around the town of Adre. The UK has provided over £200 million in humanitarian aid to help support people affected by the conflict, inside
